name: Flamingo
summary: Tall, pink, standing on a single leg.
text:
Tall and slim, standing on one dark wooden foot. The body is pale pink, the feathers drawn in with a brush, and the light comes out through the middle.

One of the tallest pieces at 44 cm. It looks right on the floor against a wall, or on a chest of drawers.

options.name: Power
options.help: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.name: Laser engraving
options.help: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
